target: BRD4-BD1, first bromodomain of human BRD4
protein_source: examples/data/stage1_targets/panel.json, the same sealed 127-residue construct Stage 1 optimized against
reference_ligand: JQ1, 31 heavy atoms, formal charge +1; not used here
ligand_role: N-carbon chain that allocates the 25 relaxed atom slots and fixes the pose. Its atom and bond assignments are replaced by the relaxed X/E; only the slot count and the predicted pose are kept.
pocket: none by design. Protocol 4.1.2 uses the complete BRD4-BD1 target with every residue an eligible contact partner, and Stage 2 inherits the Stage 1 objective unchanged. The 14-residue JQ1 pocket belongs to the 21 October pocket-directed line, not to this one.
scope: input to mosaic.small_molecule.boltz2.prepare, which runs native Boltz-2 once to establish a fixed pose. Not a claim about binding.
